establishment_scope: Prospective deterministic evidence-only integrity envelope specification, not actual input/output binding or full semantic procedure readiness
byte_rules: All digest operands are bytes; no platform newline, locale, native path or implicit Unicode normalization
Opaque exact identity strings use strict UTF-8, preserve codepoints; caller aliases/casefold/path normalization forbidden
U64(n) is unsigned 64-bit big-endian, 0 <= n < 2^64; reject oversized input
Source content digest is SHA256(exact immutable source bytes); encoded as raw 32 bytes, not textual hex
Source record R = F("C5U/source/v1", [construction_input_id, canonical_source_identity, source_content_digest]); all text operands strictly encoded as above
Source records sorted lexicographically by pair (construction_input_id UTF8 bytes, canonical_source_identity UTF8 bytes); duplicate pairs reject, source roster must independently be proved complete
V = F("C5U/procedure/v1", [approved_full_procedure_version_id, SHA256(exact approved full procedure specification bytes)])
D = SHA256(F("C5U/output-binding/v1", [M, V, exact canonical output identity bytes, exact output content bytes]))
Displayed integrity digest is lowercase hex of D; display is not an identity/authority grant
canonical_input_ordering: Exact UTF-8 byte pair lexicographic order; no source-defined relation/graph row reordering implied
canonical_serialization: Length-prefixed binary envelope; output content remains exact source-authorized canonical bytes, whose semantic serialization is NOT_ESTABLISHED
self_reference_guard: Procedure specification digest excludes generated digest/report; actual output bytes must not include their own envelope digest. Any source-required recursive encoding is unresolved and rejects.
fail_closed: Unknown canonical identity or source roster
Undefined approved procedure or output serialization/identity
Invalid UTF-8, non-byte operand, invalid length
Expected-result/status channels in transform or input roster
